Design, layout and every line: bible/NET_NEW_DESIGNS.md.

Ewok scout: brown fur, leather hood, small spear (short 16x32 body or the 16x16 kit). Used by the EWOK (ninja-boy) and SHAMAN (bug-maniac) trainers: re-point their object events to it. Bright Tree villagers can use it too. Placeholder: Chirpa's walker.
WUHER, the cantina bartender: stocky, scowling, dark hair, grey apron over a brown shirt. Stands behind the round bar (person16x32_still is enough).
Bith musician of the Modal Nodes: huge bald cranium, big black eyes, dark suit, kloo horn. One sprite for FIGRIN D'AN and DOIKK NA'TS (person16x32_still).
PONDA BABA, Aqualish thug: walrus face with two down-turned tusks, small eyes, brown leather jacket, holstered blaster.
DR. CORNELIUS EVAZAN: scarred, twisted face, dark hair, reddish-brown jacket with a high collar.
MOMAW NADON, Ithorian: tall curved hammer-shaped head with eyes at the ends, long neck, earth-coloured robes. Also usable for Ithorian HERBALISTs.
Silver protocol droid (C-3PO build, dull silver plating, one red arm). Waits outside the cantina; reusable for droids in houses and offices.
